market_summary: Gold (XAUUSD) continues a strong bearish breakdown under negative GEX amplifying regime below 4000/Gamma Flip. Major FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) remain suppressed in lower value areas with low RVOL consolidation. US100 pulls back after testing Call Wall #1 resistance in a positive GEX dampening regime. BTCUSD consolidates above VAH after a Session High rejection.

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (4027.30) and far below POC (4044.57). CVD is BEARISH (-3.30) with negative slope (-0.73), confirming strong selling pressure during NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (4034.42) and EMA50 (4021.41), pressing into the lower ATR band. Heavy selling volume confirmed earlier expansion. GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip (3998.73), with Put Wall #1 at 4015.43 broken to the downside, accelerating directional momentum lower toward next structural supports. Re-entering on breakdown continuation.
signals.level_event: rejection below Session Low / Put Wall

signals.rationale: Price is inside VA (VAL 1.10824..VAH 1.11455) and below POC (1.10920). CVD is BEARISH (-14,869) with negative slope (-580.16) in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is below VWAP (1.33064) and EMA50 (1.32982), consolidating between EMA20 baseline (1.32810) and lower ATR band (1.32697). RVOL is low at 0.246. Sitting near Session Low without volume expansion or reversal signal.

Price is above VAH (28343.60) and POC (28267.73). CVD is BULLISH (+13.19) in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is trending strongly above VWAP (28209.94) and EMA50 (28317.92). GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING above Gamma Flip (28447.02). Note that price has just hit Call Wall #1 at 28550.10 and rejected back toward EMA20 baseline (28454.74). Under positive GEX, dealers sell rips into Call Wall #1, capping immediate upside. Waiting for pullback completion or flip break before entering.

Price is above VAH (73998.28) and POC (73660.42). CVD is BEARISH/NEUTRAL (-0.07) diverging slightly from price action in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades above VWAP (73789.24) and EMA50 (73958.18), but has pulled back after testing Session High (74706.20) and is currently consolidating around EMA20 (74157.42) and S/R 74254.90. Low RVOL (0.694) with no recent spikes. Waiting for consolidation to resolve.
